title: Shelving EQ Design
text: Design tunable shelving equalizer coefficients, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Smooth tuned filter parameters} sets the smooth filter parameters when tuning, {Smoothing factor}, {Specify peak gain from input port} uses additional input port to specify gain, {Peak gain (dB)}, {Specify slope coefficient from input port} uses additional input port to specify slope, {Slope coefficient}, {Specify normalized cutoff frequency from input port} uses additional input port to specify normalized cutoff, {Normalized cutoff frequency}, {Specify filter type from input port} uses additional input port to specify filter, {Filter type} sets the type of shelving, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Sample time} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Fc
ports.summary: Normalized cutoff frequency scalar in range [0,1]

ports.name: Num
ports.summary: Numerator filter coefficients three-element row vector

ports.name: Den
ports.summary: Denominator filter coefficients three-element row vector

params.name: Smooth tuned filter parameters
params.values: Smooth filter parameters when tuning off (default) | on

params.name: Smoothing factor
params.values: Smoothing factor for tuned parameters 0.6 (default) | scalar in range [0,1)

params.name: Specify peak gain from input port
params.values: Use additional input port to specify gain off (default) | on

params.name: Specify slope coefficient from input port
params.values: Use additional input port to specify slope coefficient off (default) | on

params.name: Specify normalized cutoff frequency from input port
params.values: Use additional input port to specify normalized cutoff frequency off (default) | on

params.name: Normalized cutoff frequency
params.values: Normalized cutoff frequency 0.1 (default) | scalar in range [0,1]

params.name: Specify filter type from input port
params.values: Use additional input port to specify filter type off (default) | on

params.name: Filter type
params.values: Type of shelving equalizer low (default) | high

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output coefficients double (default) | single

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time of block -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
